o.en:
Please install the appropriate node packs that it asks you to install through ComfyUI Manager. These are pretty much the workflows I'm using.

Important: If you see"Sampling failed: . Check that all inputs are valid tensors."upon canceling it while running the KSampler in my node pack that is used in this,don't panic, that will happen and you can completely ignore it.I couldn't get that pop up error, which does nothing, to go away completely so it's just there until I do get it to go away inside that KSampler node.
